scope: development-only cached update rejection prototype, six xyz primary raw-initialized 3D-2D cases, no new solve
selection: all six development pairs, preserve solver failures/unsupported pairs; no desk/room/teddy run
gate: solver must have applied; >=6 odd source rows; all check projections positive; check median <=4 pixels (V12 sigma2 times Huber delta2), and <=raw initial median with1e-9 tolerance; any failure returns full raw transform exactly
check_data: original odd source-feature rows formerly called validation; now decision inputs, no longer independent evaluation. Cached native source depth and target pixels, no target depth in gate residual. Original target-depth eligibility still present. No new matches or retuning.
truth_use: guard-only finalized before reading recorded V12 evaluation; truth never used in gate. Synthetic CLI test verifies changing evaluation labels leaves guard-only identical.
acceptance: all6 decisions and exact rejected-transform rollback; at least1 accepted update; no accepted update materially worsens raw truth >5mm/0.5deg under either timestamp protocol; every accepted update meets3cm/2deg in both protocols; >=1 accepted pair has V12 meaningful improvement against raw baseline; >=1 inaccurate converged candidate rejected; all-case selected medians must not worsen unguarded >5mm/0.5deg. This is development evidence only, not universal rejection accuracy.
limitations: earlier test-scene failures motivated this development-only gate; no fresh independence claim
median bound can hide up to nearly half bad checks, demonstrated by unit test
raw fallback may already be inaccurate and rejection can discard an actual improvement
decision checks cannot also be reported as independent geometric holdout
no map/BA/trajectory/tracking feedback or test replay; no test-derived threshold calibration
stop: finish one six-pair cached development replay and full Python regression; no threshold changes after results or subsequent scene replay
